data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 1,103.3m. During 2017 the Syndicate recorded an aggregate release from prior year reserves of GBP 59.2m driven by more favourable claims development and efficient claims handling, partially offset by a GBP 52.4m strengthening resulting from the UK Ogden discount rate change which adversely impacted reserves on 2014 and prior Motor treaty business. The 2017 underwriting result was further impacted by GBP 74.7m of natural catastrophe losses (Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico City earthquake, California wildfires, Nate) in Q3-Q4. A RITC accepted from Syndicate 1400 also materially increased gross reserves in the prior year.
raw_causal_phrases: release from prior year reserves of GBP 59.2m (2016, GBP 57.6m release).
This release is a result of more favourable claims development than originally anticipated and the work of our claims department in dealing with claims in an expeditious manner.

a change to the Ogden discount rate. On February 27, 2017 the UK Ministry of Justice announced that the discount rate in the Ogden tables will decrease from 2.5% to minus 0.75%. As a result of this reduction the reserves held on the 2014 and prior years of account relating to UK Motor Treaty business have been adversely impacted, resulting in a GBP 52.4m strengthening to the prior year losses.

GBP 74.7m of natural catastrophe losses arising during the third and fourth quarters of 2017; (hurricane Harvey; hurricane Irma; hurricane Maria; Mexico City earthquake; Northern California wildfires; hurricane Nate; Southern California wildfires).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement value (-GBP 59.2m) is taken from narrative which explicitly states a 'release from prior year reserves of GBP 59.2m'. The report does not present a single explicit GROSS 'movement in prior years' line; triangulation is complicated by a large RITC accepted from Syndicate 1400 (gross GBP 248.822k) which distorts the gross claims development table. Therefore the prior year development figure used is the explicitly stated release (likely reported net of reinsurance in narrative); no gross-only prior-year movement figure was clearly provided. Claims development triangle is present but includes an 'All prior years' column and RITC distortions; use with caution.
